comment: Per-file exemptions of the publication checker (scripts/check-public.sh passes this file as --exempt). Exact paths only, one reason each; test_exemptions.py enforces that. Only the product-name rule may be exempted here: omp-memory imports the memory files of other coding tools, so the files below have to name them (as data sources, identifiers such as the `claude-memory` source id, and file locations). Nothing else is exempted.

ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/README.md: the plugin's guide: says which tools' memory files it reads and imports
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/docs/threat-model.md: the threat model of reading and importing those tools' memory files
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/python/omp_memory/cli: the usage text lists the sources `sources` scans
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/python/omp_memory/cor: scans the sources it reports on, by name
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/python/omp_memory/inf: the `sources` command's help and output name the sources
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/python/omp_memory/ops: the import help names the importer's `--source claude-memory` value
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/python/omp_memory/saf: `claude-memory` is the importer's default --source value, part of the dry-run hash
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/scripts/smoke.sh: builds synthetic memory files in the layout of those tools and runs the import on them
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/skills/omp-memory/SKI: tells an agent which memory sources exist and how to import them safely
test fixtures in the layout of those tools' files
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_ban: tests the source scan against fixtures in the layout of those tools' files
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_imp: tests the wrapper's handling of the importer's `--source claude-memory` argument
runs the real importer on synthetic files in the layout of those tools
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_saf: tests the backup and dry-run records of an import from those sources
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/SOURCE.sha256: a list of vendored file paths; two of them carry a tool's name (claude-mem)
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/hindsight_impo: recognises the origin names the importer writes into banks (claude-code, claude-mem)
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/hindsight_prox: secret patterns for the key prefixes of two model vendors' API keys (a comment names them)
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/memory_import/: the importer's reference: the three sources it reads, by name
the importer's usage text and `--source` values (claude-memory, claude-mem-summaries)
runs the import of those sources; source ids and messages name them
decodes the project-directory names that Claude Code writes
the source ids (claude-code, claude-mem) that every imported row records
a comment on the `claude-memory` mode of the redaction bridge
the write test's synthetic rows carry the importer's source ids (`claude-code`, `claude-mem`)
reads claude-mem's session summaries (its database and session files)
tests the claude-mem source; the file name is that project's name
uses the importer's `claude-memory` source name in a fixture
tests the import guards with a claude-memory run
builds scratch homes with Claude Code project directories
tests the import of Claude Code memory files into scratch banks
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/omp_hub/memory: finds the instruction files those tools read (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, ...) by their names
a comment on the origin names written by the importer
the source kinds a memory item can come from, by name
scans the memory locations of those tools, by name
ai-name.tools/public-tree-check/exemptions.json: this list: its reasons and one exempt file name carry those tools' names
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_wra: tests the wrapper's handling of the importer's `--source claude-memory` flags and a smoke script
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/memory_import/: tests the importer's reading of the memory files of those tools (source ids claude-code, claude-mem)
tests the importer's writes with rows whose source id is claude-code
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_sta: tests the state, configuration and labels destinations with a `--source claude-memory` importer stand-in
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/tests/python/test_sec: feeds recognised secrets into names in the layout of those tools' files and checks no command prints them
ai-name.plugins/omp-memory/vendor/memory_import/: feeds recognised secrets into source ids, folders and files of those tools and checks no command prints them
the importer's command line: names the sources it reads (claude-memory, claude-mem) in its usage text and options
runs the importer's entry point with a stand-in `--source claude-memory` command
